engine: Transparent KPI Scorecard + Forward Health Transition Predictor

architecture_distinction.scorecard_concept: Transparent Weighted Scorecard (0-100) — Rule-based descriptive operational health indicator, NOT a supervised ML model. Evaluated for diagnostic sanity (bounds, monotonicity, volatility).
architecture_distinction.classification_concept: Operational Risk Categorizer (A-F grading and Green/Amber/Red traffic lights) — Descriptive categorization mapping score intervals to management actions.
architecture_distinction.transition_prediction_concept: Forward-Looking Transition Regressor (Linear Regression winner) — Supervised regression predicting next month's scorecard score H_{t+1} from current period KPIs H_t.
architecture_distinction.evaluation_limitations: The forward transition model is evaluated against next month's deterministic scorecard score, not empirical bankruptcy/loan default data. Predictive validation is strictly limited to forward ratio tracking.
